program='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seed = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 8]
    top = min(r for r, c in seed)
    left = min(c for r, c in seed)
    pattern = [(r - top, c - left) for r, c in seed]
    max_r = max(r for r, c in pattern)
    max_c = max(c for r, c in pattern)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h - max_r):
        for c in range(w - max_c):
            cells = [(r + dr, c + dc) for dr, dc in pattern]
            if all(grid[rr][cc] == 0 for rr, cc in cells):
                for rr, cc in cells:
                    out[rr][cc] = 8
    return out
'''
